full_judgment: 38. From the above made discussion we therefore hold that plaintiff has failed to prove his case. In Title Suit 591 of 2015 and in Title Appeal 38 of 2018 the courts below committed error of law occasioning failure of justice in decreeing the suit upon misreading and non consideration of material evidence affecting the merit of the case. The trial Court also erred in law in dismissing Title Suit 432 of 2015 upon fanciful consideration. The title of defendant 6 is hereby declared in respect of 5(Five) katha land equivalent to 825 ajutangsho and the city survey khan= 456 is hereby corrected by inserting 103 ajutangsho in the name of defendant 6. Plaintiff shall deliver khas possession of 103 ajutangsho of land to defendant 6 as described in the 'Kha' schedule to the plaint within 60(sixty) days otherwise defendant 6 shall recover such possession through Court.
